proposal: CW design flow 38,000 m3/h; IG-04 valid over 36,050-38,000 m3/h with the correction curve.
question: The condenser needs 36,050 m3/h at SRC (7 K rise) against the indicative 43,000-47,000 m3/h of ER-07.11. The EPC proposes to size the CW system for 38,000 m3/h (margin for fouling, tube plugging and cold-ambient duty). Please confirm the condenser performance at 38,000 m3/h and the tube velocity limit, and whether IG-04 can be stated for 36,050-38,000 m3/h.
response: Confirmed: at 38,000 m3/h the condenser pressure at SRC is 33.8 mbar(a), rise 6.6 K, tube velocity 2.2 m/s (upper ER-07.07 limit - do not exceed 38,000 m3/h). IG-04 applies from 36,050 to 38,000 m3/h with the correction curve in PER-001 Rev A.
subject: Circulating water design flow and condenser guarantee conditions
